verdict.rationale: Granola offers a REST API and MCP server for programmatic access to meeting notes/summaries, plus a Zapier integration claiming to connect to 8,000+ apps (which could include Linear/Jira/Asana) and a native HubSpot CRM sync — providing plausible paths for automating action-item filing. However there is no first-party documentation of a native Linear/Jira/Asana connector, no dedicated 'action items' extraction endpoint, and no documented recipe/automation specifically for project trackers; a community developer built a separate third-party kanban tool rather than Granola shipping this natively. Missing for 10: native Linear/Jira/Asana integrations, first-party docs on syncing action items (not just notes) to trackers, and independent verification that the Zapier path actually works for this use case.
